title: Four colour theorem
statement: Every planar map can be coloured with four colours so that neighbouring regions differ.
how_it_was_proved: Appel and Haken (1977) by discharging and an unavoidable set of reducible configurations checked by computer; Gonthier (2005) checked a proof following Robertson, Sanders, Seymour and Thomas in Coq.

sources.cite: K. Appel and W. Haken, Illinois J. Math. 21 (1977) 429-490
G. Gonthier, Formal proof: the four-color theorem, Notices Amer. Math. Soc. 55 (2008) 1382-1393

steps.statement: Discharging: every planar triangulation contains a configuration from a fixed finite set
Each configuration of the set is reducible, checked by computation
